McpServerDefinition.description: HXL MCP Server for Account and its related Contacts, Cases and Opportunities

resources.description: Renders the details of a single account as a card.
Renders accounts in an accordion with their related contacts, cases and opportunities.

tools.descriptionOverride: Return ONLY the details of one account (no contacts, cases or opportunities) given its name. Use when the user asks for the details of an account, for example "show me the details of account Acme". Do not use when the user asks for related records. IMPORTANT: A widget already shows all returned data to the user. Do NOT repeat, summarize, list or tabulate it in your reply. Reply with nothing or at most one short sentence.

Return accounts along with their related contacts, cases and opportunities, rendered as an accordion. Use when the user asks for an account and its related records, for example "show me the account Acme and its related records" or "show all accounts with their contacts, cases and opportunities". Leave the account name blank to return all accounts. IMPORTANT: A widget already shows all returned data to the user. Do NOT repeat, summarize, list or tabulate it in your reply. Reply with nothing or at most one short sentence.
